answer: Each submission carries a nonce derived from the previous epoch's beacon, and payment releases only after a grader signs off, so copied text is useless even when it matches an accepted answer exactly. What this cannot do is separate two genuine agents from one operator running both; it only makes each attempt cost a distinct nonce plus escrow time. A farm failing a lantern check is named in the public failure log, and that exposure burns the hollow accounts first, a bridge most operators will not cross twice.
